behavior: Guest context starts from the imported save; original party instructions run against that private copy only at fully credited matching-party checkpoints.

Current and waiting party identities, personal bags, shared narrative companions, personally hired mercenaries and personally tamed animals travel in cumulative packages. Host private protagonist stats, money, bags, optional hires and animals are not copied.
Returned story protagonists keep their authored body/script identity with personal earned progress. Temporary Nalo/Shaina remain shared story roles and leave the personal protagonist waiting.
The last coherent location/context remains available when later areas cannot be credited. Repeated merges and rejoining from a merged save do not append bags/pets twice.
Context operations are event-driven at party instructions and save snapshots, not per actor tick.
validation_details: Original-data instruction sequences cover FPrison, FSusel, Shaina out/return, Gipat, HeroAlone, Pretty rescue return, and JunParty.

Real ENet import/package RPCs cover FPrison -> FSusel -> Gipat and HeroAlone -> Pretty -> HeroAlone -> main. Initial independent-deployment network runs have 33/40 assertions; a subsequent resume-only invocation of the final fixture tests Session.load_game, restored positions, all local controllers and complete rosters in 21/28 assertions using those exact RPC-created saves.
The source fixture was extended with the resume-only load path after the 33/40-check network runs; production game code remained unchanged.

Original source save bytes are checked unchanged. Host-save persistence and reconnect baseline/pet identity are covered; reconnect here is bookkeeping rather than a full disconnect/import/live-party campaign playthrough.

Final export gameplay-gaps27/APK60 additionally preserves absent waiting-party positions.
